title: Linux Possible GSM Privilege Escalation
author: Raven Tait, Splunk
description:
The following analytic detects the commands used in a race condition found in the GSM 0710 tty multiplexor in the Linux kernel.
This issue occurs when two threads execute the GSMIOC_SETCONF ioctl on the same tty file descriptor with the gsm line discipline enabled.
This could allow a local unprivileged user to escalate their privileges on the system.
